requests.summary: Current Angular viewer HTML retrieved; embedded state showed public endpoints and EPSG:32644 map workflow.
Viewer labels identified District, Tehsil and Village.
Anonymous form-encoded discovery returned district 140 गाजियाबाद, tehsil 00738 मोदीनगर, and village records including safe-data flags.
Bounded village extent response returned CRS EPSG:32644 and GIS code for Modinagar-tehsil villages; this is map extent evidence, not citywide coverage.
Safe plot lookup returned native kide/id and bounding-box fields for a sampled Modinagar-tehsil village; no full geometry was returned by this route.
Full-polygon route returned Missing or invalid Authorization header. No credential, token, login, CAPTCHA bypass or TLS exception was attempted.
UP cadastral digitization dashboard reports village/mapsheet linkage and georeferencing status by district; it is status evidence, not a parcel vector API.
